# Gerardo Castaneda — Websites for Small Businesses

> I build simple, fast one-page websites for local businesses.

## Who this is for

Local businesses that need a page customers can find: who you are, what you do,
your hours, and a way to call or message you. Built for shops in and around
Glennville, Georgia and Tattnall County.

## Services

- One-page business websites (who you are, what you do, hours, contact)
- Ordering and contact forms that send straight to your inbox
- Update-it-yourself sites you can edit without a developer

## How it works

1. You reach out — tell me about your business.
2. Free mockup — you see the page before you pay anything.
3. I build your site — one focused week. The build is a flat fee, named before I start.
4. It's yours — I'll show you how to update it, and I'm a message away.

## Selected work

- RaeMa's Remedies — family wellness brand; order system that sends orders to
  the owner's inbox. https://raemas-remedies.vercel.app
- Better Than Gold Tallow Co. — farm product site.
  https://better-than-gold-tallow.vercel.app

Theos Logos (https://theos-logos-official.vercel.app) is a personal Bible study
app, not a client site.

## About

I'm Gerardo Castaneda — Rardo. Husband, father of two, musician, photographer.
Born in Siguatepeque, Honduras; now in Glennville, Georgia. Started learning to
build software in 2026 with AI as my tutor. "Living for the glory of God is life's
purpose."
